identification: Nine wooden explosives boxes, mostly finger (box) jointed pine 50 lb gelignite cases by Nobel (Australasia) Pty Ltd, mid 20th century, open (no lids visible). End stencils read 'BULK 1/4 X 8' with '...GELIGNITE 60' (60% gelignite, 1 1/4 in sticks); side roundels in the Nobel (Australasia) style with 'WITH CARE KEEP DRY' and 'AUTHORITY No 42' lines. One box end painted green, one painted with a pale patterned design, one darker stained box, and a dark narrow stained box standing upright (possibly a different/detonator-type box). Weathered, stained, usable decor condition.

viewing_check: Count the nine and check for any lids; read each roundel (Nobel (Australasia), ICIANZ, Alfred Nobel, Polar Ajax, Authority No); check what the dark narrow box is (detonator boxes sell better) and whether the painted ends hide stencils. Check for borer and rot.
